products.what_it_changes: Heat-induction hardened steel rear sprocket with zinc-black finish. Gearing change. JT's own catalogue page states: 'Lower gear ratios allow for higher top speeds. Higher gear ratios increase torque for better acceleration' - i.e. more rear teeth / fewer front teeth = shorter gearing (harder pull, lower top speed per gear).
products.supporting_parts: 520-pitch chain; JT's per-bike pages list the chain length (see the JT chain entry). Replace chain and both sprockets together.
products.caveats: Part number format PN.teeth follows JT's catalogue search example ('JTF513.15'). 'Available Sizes' lists the tooth counts JT shows for that bike page; the tooth count in each fit note is the size JT's catalogue page shows for the bike (its gear-ratio chart marks it 'standard'). No prices on the JT site; buy via dealers.

products.what_it_changes: Rubber-cushioned countershaft sprocket, OE type (quieter running). Gearing change. JT's own catalogue page states: 'Lower gear ratios allow for higher top speeds. Higher gear ratios increase torque for better acceleration' - i.e. more rear teeth / fewer front teeth = shorter gearing (harder pull, lower top speed per gear).
products.supporting_parts: 520-pitch chain; JT's per-bike pages list the chain length (see the JT chain entry). Replace chain and both sprockets together.
products.caveats: Part number format PN.teeth follows JT's catalogue search example ('JTF513.15'). 'Available Sizes' lists the tooth counts JT shows for that bike page; the tooth count in each fit note is the size JT's catalogue page shows for the bike (its gear-ratio chart marks it 'standard'). No prices on the JT site; buy via dealers.
